name: London — CMHC average rent, two-bedroom purpose-built apartment, October 2025
description: Survey average monthly rent for a two-bedroom unit in privately initiated purpose-built rental apartments, London CMA, from CMHC's October 2025 Rental Market Survey. Includes occupied and vacant units; not an asking rent.

attributes.notes: CMHC London CMA, private apartments, two-bedroom: October 2024 average $1,548; October 2025 $1,651 (quality 'a', excellent). year_over_year_change_pct is CMHC's same-sample estimate of rent change (Table 1.1.5), quality 'b'. Universe: 26,597 two-bedroom units of 49,202 private apartment units.

sources.title: Rental Market Survey Data Tables, London CMA, 2025 (Tables 1.1.2 and 1.1.5)
sources.methodology: CMHC Rental Market Survey, October 2025: privately initiated purpose-built rental apartment structures of three or more units; survey of landlords/property managers; quality grades a–d, ** = suppressed.

sources.title: Table 34-10-0133-01, CMHC average rents for areas with a population of 10,000 and over — London, Ontario, apartment structures of three units and over, two bedroom units (vector v3824160)
sources.methodology: Republication of the CMHC Rental Market Survey October figure; retrieved through the Web Data Service, value matches the CMHC table.

verification.notes: Value read from the CMHC Excel data table downloaded on 2026-10-30; cross-checked against Statistics Canada vector v3824160.

limitations: Average across all sitting tenants and vacant units, so it lags market (turnover) rents and asking rents. Excludes condominium rentals, secondary suites and houses. Survey month is October 2025; CMHC's October 2026 survey is expected around December 2026. Average, not median.
